fullPassage: Life is insecure and human well-being is fragile. If we are honest with ourselves, we realize that, despite our best efforts, we often cannot control the vicissitudes of human existence. We go through life in fear and trembling, fearing what may happen, while hoping for the best. Most of us get anxious in the face of an indeterminate or ambiguous situation. We don’t handle uncertainty very well. We are easily tempted to settle for quick “solutions,” in order to eliminate our anxiety and doubt, even though these quick fixes may not, in the long run, actually be adequate solutions. It is natural, therefore, and even somewhat necessary, for us to seek stability in a sea of change and indeterminacy. We want a fixed star to guide us on our journey through hazardous waters. If only we could have knowledge of what is fixed, unchanging, and ultimately reliable, then, we assume, that would be knowledge most worth having.

questions.passage: Life is insecure and human well-being is fragile. If we are honest with ourselves, we realize that, despite our best efforts, we often cannot control the vicissitudes of human existence. We go through life in fear and trembling, fearing what may happen, while hoping for the best. Most of us get anxious in the face of an indeterminate or ambiguous situation. We don’t handle uncertainty very well. We are easily tempted to settle for quick “solutions,” in order to eliminate our anxiety and doubt, even though <u>these</u> quick fixes may not, in the long run, actually be adequate solutions. It is natural, therefore, and even somewhat necessary, for us to seek stability in a sea of change and indeterminacy. We want a fixed star to guide us on our journey through hazardous waters. If only we could have knowledge of what is fixed, unchanging, and ultimately reliable, then, we assume, that would be knowledge most worth having.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 these가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: these quick fixes — 앞에 나온 quick solutions를 가리킴
det.analysis:
❌ ① vicissitudes는 앞선 문장의 주제이지 these의 직접 지시 대상이 아님
✅ ② these quick fixes = 앞의 'quick solutions'를 가리킴. 빠른 해결책들 ←정답
❌ ③ indeterminate situations는 더 먼 문장의 내용
❌ ④ anxiety and doubt는 제거 대상이지 these의 지시 대상이 아님
det.tip: these quick fixes — 앞 문장의 quick solutions를 지칭
